# Muto Runtime: Runtime Hot-Swap Library for Fabric Mods

> Author: fy2ne (@fy2ne)
> Architecture: Runtime Knot Classpath Injection & MappedRegistry Thawing
> Type: Developer Library (client-side engine, no in-game UI)
> Target: Minecraft Java Edition | Fabric Loader | Java 25+
> Package: me.fy2ne.muto (Maven group me.fy2ne, artifact muto)
> Website: https://muto.fy2ne.me
> Modrinth: https://modrinth.com/project/muto
> Repository: https://github.com/fy2ne/muto
> License: GNU LGPL-3.0-only - c 2026 fy2ne. https://www.gnu.org/licenses/lgpl-3.0.html

## What Muto Runtime Is

Muto Runtime is a **developer library** - not a player-facing mod. It provides the JVM-level
runtime primitives that make it possible to load, unload, and hot-swap Fabric mods while
Minecraft is running, with no restart. It adds no UI to Minecraft itself; you depend on it from
your own mod and call its API.

The runtime is split into Fabric Loader integration (the `me.fy2ne.muto.engine.knot` package
appends jars to Knot's classpath and `me.fy2ne.muto.engine.mixin` registers dynamic mixin configs)
and the engine (`me.fy2ne.muto.engine.ReloadEngine`, which orchestrates the swap). The public API
is `me.fy2ne.muto.api`.

## How It Works

1. **Knot Classpath Injection** - a newly added or updated mod jar is appended to Fabric Loader's
   running Knot classpath (with nested jars) by `me.fy2ne.muto.engine.knot.KnotInjector`, so its
   classes resolve without a restart.
2. **Registry Thawing** - Minecraft freezes `MappedRegistry` at boot. Muto clears the `frozen`
   flag (Mixin accessor, reflective fallback), prunes entries for the removed/updated mod's
   namespace, lets the new version re-register, then refreezes.
3. **Dynamic Mixin Registration** - `me.fy2ne.muto.engine.mixin.DynamicMixinEngine` registers the
   new jar's mixin configs with the global Mixin service. They apply to every class the JVM defines
   after the reload; already-loaded classes cannot be re-woven.

## Pipeline Stages

scan -> diff (hash) -> inject jars into Knot -> register dynamic mixin configs -> prune namespace
entries -> unfreeze registries -> re-run ModInitializer -> refreeze registries -> sync keybindings
-> sync Fabric Loader metadata.

## Integration

External mods declare Muto as an optional soft-dependency using `modCompileOnly` and guard every
call with `MutoApi.isAvailable()`.

### Gradle

```groovy
repositories {
    maven {
        name = "Modrinth"
        url = "https://api.modrinth.com/maven"
    }
}
dependencies {
    modCompileOnly "maven.modrinth:muto:0.3.0-beta"
}
```

The library build is also published to GitHub Packages as `me.fy2ne:muto`.

### Runtime Detection and Reload

```java
import net.fabricmc.loader.api.FabricLoader;
import me.fy2ne.muto.api.MutoApi;

public class ReloadIntegration {
    public static void onModJarChanged(java.nio.file.Path jarPath) {
        if (!FabricLoader.getInstance().isModLoaded("muto") || !MutoApi.isAvailable()) return;

        if (MutoApi.isSafeToReload()) {
            MutoApi.reloadAsync(stage -> System.out.println("[muto] " + stage))
                .thenAccept(result -> {
                    if (result.success()) {
                        System.out.println("hot-swapped in " + result.durationMs() + "ms");
                    } else {
                        System.err.println("swap failed: " + result.error());
                    }
                });
        }
    }
}
```

### Lifecycle Event Hooks

```java
import me.fy2ne.muto.api.MutoEvents;

MutoEvents.RELOAD_START.register((startMs, diff) -> {
    // close stale connections, clear texture caches
});

MutoEvents.RELOAD_FINISH.register((endMs, diff, success, durationMs, error) -> {
    // refresh caches, re-bind resources
});
```

## Public API (`me.fy2ne.muto.api.MutoApi`)

- `isAvailable()`: boolean - Muto is loaded and ready
- `isReloading()`: boolean - reload transaction is currently running
- `isSafeToReload()`: boolean - client is on the title screen, not in a world
- `plan()`: ReloadPlan - scan /mods and compute a diff without executing
- `reloadAsync()`: CompletableFuture<ReloadResult> - trigger async hot-swap
- `reloadAsync(Consumer<String> stageNotifier)`: CompletableFuture<ReloadResult> - with per-stage progress
- `getReloadableModIds()`: Set<String> - all dynamically reloadable mods (Tier 1 + Tier 2)
- `getStubbornModIds()`: Set<String> - core mods that require a restart (Tier 3)
- `startFileWatcher()` / `stopFileWatcher()`: boolean - control the opt-in muto.trigger watcher
- `isFileWatcherRunning()`: boolean

Records: `ReloadResult(boolean success, ModDiff diff, long durationMs, String error)`,
`ReloadPlan(ModSnapshot currentSnapshot, ModSnapshot targetSnapshot, ModDiff diff, List<ScannedMod>
reloadable, List<ScannedMod> stubborn)`, `ModDiff(Set added, Set removed, Set updated,
Set unchanged)`.

## Mod Tier Classification

- **Tier 1 (Clean)**: pure client tweaks - HUDs, visual mods. Reloads without touching registries.
- **Tier 2 (Standard)**: content mods - blocks, items, recipes, dimensions. Full pipeline: Knot
  injection, registry thaw, re-run ModInitializer, refreeze.
- **Tier 3 (Stubborn)**: Fabric Loader, Fabric API, `muto` itself, and deeply-woven mixins. Their
  classes are already loaded and mixin-woven, so they cannot be reloaded without a JVM restart.

## Building and Testing

- Build: `./gradlew build` (compile, test, assemble). Jar: `./gradlew jar`.
- Dev client: `./gradlew runClient`. Fast-refresh loop: `./gradlew mutoWatch` (see
  `muto-watcher.gradle`).
- Tests: JUnit 5 - `junit-jupiter-api` 5.11.4, `junit-jupiter-engine` 5.11.4 and
  `junit-platform-launcher` 1.11.4, wired into the Loom `test` source set. Run with `./gradlew
  test`; HTML report at `build/reports/tests/test/index.html`.
- Test classes: `ModStateManagerTest`, `ModTierClassificationTest`, `ReloadShellTest`,
  `api.MutoApiTest`.
- CI: `.github/workflows/build.yml` (Temurin JDK 25, `./gradlew build`, uploads jar + test report)
  and `.github/workflows/publish.yml` (GitHub Packages, on release or a 26.x version bump).

## Source Layout

- `src/main/java/me/fy2ne/muto/api` - public surface (`MutoApi`, `MutoEvents`, `ModDiff`)
- `src/main/java/me/fy2ne/muto/engine` - `ReloadEngine`, `ModScanner`, `ModSnapshot`,
  `RegistryFreezer`, `MutoClassLoader`, `ReloadPlan`, `ReloadResult`
- `src/main/java/me/fy2ne/muto/engine/knot` - Knot classpath injection and reflection access
- `src/main/java/me/fy2ne/muto/engine/mixin` - dynamic mixin registration
- `src/main/java/me/fy2ne/muto/mixin` - accessors and injections against Minecraft internals
- `src/main/java/me/fy2ne/muto/mods` - disk mod state and disabled-mods registry
- `src/main/java/me/fy2ne/muto/config` - `MutoConfig` (config/muto.json)
- `src/main/resources` - `fabric.mod.json`, `muto.mixins.json`, assets

## Platform

- Minecraft: Java Edition 26.x (26.1, 26.1.1, 26.1.2, 26.2, 26.3)
- Loader: Fabric Loader >= 0.16.0 (developed against 0.19.5)
- Fabric API: >= 0.144.1 (build target 0.161.0+26.3)
- Java: 25+
- Environment: Client-side only
- License: GNU Lesser General Public License v3.0 (LGPL-3.0-only) - c 2026 fy2ne. Use it and link it from any
  mod, including closed-source ones; modifications to Muto itself must stay open under the LGPL.
  https://www.gnu.org/licenses/lgpl-3.0.html

A JDK with class-redefinition support (JBR/DCEVM) is not required; Muto reloads by injecting jars
into Knot and re-running initializers.
